name: esitef
install:
cd esitef-platform && npm install && { [ -f apps/web/.env.local ] || printf 'DATABASE_URL=postgresql://esitef:esitef@localhost:5433/esitef
AUTH_SECRET=%s
AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
' "$(openssl rand -base64 32)" > apps/web/.env.local; }
start: sudo service docker start && cd esitef-platform && docker compose up -d && until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U esitef -d esitef >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done && npm run db:push && npm run seed

terminals.name: dev server
terminals.description: Next.js dev server en :3000. Usuario demo: demo@esitef.com / demo1234
